title: Healthy Cooking on a Budget in Bucharest
description: How to eat healthily in Bucharest for about 100 lei a week per person. You will learn where and when to shop (Obor and the other markets, the discount supermarkets, loyalty apps and weekly offers), what is in season in Romania month by month, and how to compare unit prices and the cost of protein, fiber and energy per leu. You will stock a budget pantry, store food safely without waste, batch cook two sessions a week, and cook dry beans, lentils and chickpeas. The recipes are Romanian classics in healthy, budget versions (ciorbă de fasole, mâncare de linte, tocăniță, ghiveci, varză călită cu pui, baked mackerel, mămăligă with cheese and eggs, salads and fasole bătută), each with its cost and nutrients per portion. The course ends with a costed, nutrition-checked week of menus and its shopping list, built with small Node.js tools that use a price file you can update from your own receipts.
